cardReferenceFindings.conclusion: The flagged memos contain document references, not card suffixes. Taking the final four digits of those document numbers would fabricate a card reference.
cardReferenceFindings.structuredFieldCheck: REST GET responses for payments 354563/653354 and refund 357394 did not expose card or payment-option fields to this integration role. This does not prove such information cannot exist elsewhere.
cardReferenceFindings.confirmedBusinessChoice: User rejected combining all Debit Card payments and clarified that balances with the same last four should combine. Summary grouping remains customer, payment method, last four, currency and subsidiary across invoices. Missing last fours remain unresolved and separate by source payment. No script policy change required.

refundFindings.explanation: Historical cash refund includes tax. v2 intentionally requires review because the current cash allocation rate is 40 and 452 is not a whole multiple of 40. This is separate from card parsing.

Credit is split between a cash refund and an invoice application. Neither monetary leg corresponds directly to a whole number of 40-dollar cash pallets. Original allocation and settlement quantities need an explicit rule or review.
